purpose: Records every job the clinic sends to a lab (prostheses, crowns, aligners, splints…) and shows which stage it is in, how many days it has been there and whether it is overdue, so no request gets lost and no fitting is booked before the job arrives.
tips: By default the list shows every order, including those that reached a final stage; the Stage filter can show only pending ones or a specific stage.

An order is overdue when it has spent more days in its stage than that stage's limit, or when its due date has passed (from the next day) and it has not reached a final stage. In a final stage it is never overdue. Each reason is shown separately: the days in stage in red next to the stage limit (“5 days · max 3”) and the red “N days past due” tag. Pending orders without a lab carry the amber “No lab” tag.

The lab is chosen from the providers that belong to a laboratory category (provider groups marked as such). If the order’s services all share one category, the selector starts filtered by it. An order can be created without a lab, but to move it to a stage that is not final you must say which lab it is sent to.
Every stage change is recorded in the order history, with the user and the date.

The delivery date isn't entered when the order is created: it is asked for when the order is sent, that is, moved from the initial stage to a stage that isn't final, and it is required. It can be changed later from “Edit”.
On the board, drag a card to another column to change its stage; it saves on drop and, if saving fails, the card goes back. On a phone or with the keyboard use “Move to…” in the card menu.
Changes made by other users show up on their own, without reloading.

lab-orders.btn.new.label: New order
lab-orders.btn.new.description: Opens the new order form. The order starts in the initial stage, without a delivery date: the date is asked for when it is sent to the lab.

lab-orders.section.filters.label: Search and filters
lab-orders.section.filters.description: Search by patient, job, lab or number, and the Filters button with stage (all, pending or a specific one), lab, doctor, patient, creation dates and sorting.

lab-orders.field.overdue-only.label: Overdue only
lab-orders.field.overdue-only.description: Shows only overdue orders: those that went over the days set for their current stage or are past their due date. Red when active.

lab-orders.section.detail-stage.label: Current stage
lab-orders.section.detail-stage.description: The stage the order is in, the days it has been there (red when over the limit) and the reason if it is overdue. Below, the progress through the stages and the buttons to move it.

lab-orders.btn.move-to.label: Other stage…
lab-orders.btn.move-to.description: Menu with every other stage, to skip stages, go back or close the order (for example, cancel it). It is recorded in the history. If the order has no lab and the stage is not final, it asks for the lab first.

lab-orders.section.history.label: Stage history
lab-orders.section.history.description: Each stage change with source, target, user, date and time, and how long the order stayed in each stage (“Stayed 4 days”). The first one marks the current stage.

lab-orders.btn.edit.label: Edit
lab-orders.btn.edit.description: Changes the order details (not the stage).

lab-orders.btn.delete.label: Delete
lab-orders.btn.delete.description: Removes the order from the list and the board.

lab-orders.section.view.label: List or board
lab-orders.section.view.description: The list has every filter; the board shows one column per active stage, in the configured order.

lab-orders.section.board.label: Board
lab-orders.section.board.description: One column per stage. Cards show patient, job, lab (or "No lab"), due date ("N days past due" once it passes) and days in stage, in red when over the limit. Columns can be collapsed.

lab-orders.field.final-days.label: Final columns
lab-orders.field.final-days.description: Final stages only show orders that arrived in the chosen last days, so they do not grow forever.

lab-orders.section.detail.label: Order detail
lab-orders.section.detail.description: Panel with the current stage, the progress, “Move to…” and “Other stage…”, the job, the order details, the notes and the history. From the header you can edit, delete, expand or close it.

lab-orders.btn.filters.label: Filters
lab-orders.btn.filters.description: Opens the rest of the filters. The number shows how many are applied.

lab-orders.section.services.label: Services
lab-orders.section.services.description: The work requested from the lab, picked from services flagged as “Lab work”. You can add several, each with its own quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.btn.add-service.label: Add service
lab-orders.btn.add-service.description: Finds a lab service and adds it to the order. If it does not exist you can create it here, and it is flagged as lab work.

lab-orders.btn.remove-service.label: Remove service
lab-orders.btn.remove-service.description: Removes that service from the order.

lab-orders.field.items.quantity.label: Quantity
lab-orders.field.items.quantity.description: How many units of that service are requested (1 to 99).

lab-orders.field.items.teeth.label: Teeth
lab-orders.field.items.teeth.description: The teeth for that service. The order’s teeth are all its services’ teeth combined.

lab-orders.field.items.notes.label: Service note
lab-orders.field.items.notes.description: Instructions for that service only (shade, material…).

lab-orders.section.detail-services.label: Order services
lab-orders.section.detail-services.description: The requested services with quantity, teeth and note.

lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.label: Laboratory
lab-orders.field.laboratory_id.description: Which lab the order is sent to. Optional when creating. Only labs are listed; they can be filtered by category and, if missing, created right there by choosing its category.

lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.label: Choose laboratory
lab-orders.section.choose-laboratory.description: Shows up when the order is sent (moved from the initial stage to a non-final one): it asks for the delivery date, which is required, and for the lab if the order has none yet. It also shows up when an order without a lab is moved to a non-final stage. Moving to a final stage asks for nothing.

lab-orders.field.send-due-date.label: Delivery date
lab-orders.field.send-due-date.description: The date the lab promised. It is required and can't be earlier than today; if the order already had one that hasn't passed, it comes filled in. From the next day, if the order hasn't reached a final stage, it becomes overdue.

lab-orders.section.detail-laboratory.label: Laboratory
lab-orders.section.detail-laboratory.description: The assigned lab with its categories and the details from its provider record: phones (you can dial them), email, address and RUT. If it has none, it says they are added in Purchases → Providers.

lab-orders.section.active-filters.label: Applied filters
lab-orders.section.active-filters.description: One chip per applied filter from the Filters button; the ✕ removes it and "Clear filters" removes them all. On the board, filters that do not apply there (stage, patient, dates) are dashed.

lab-orders.btn.open-patient.label: Open in Patients
lab-orders.btn.open-patient.description: Opens Patients searching for the order's patient.

lab-orders.btn.next-stage.label: Move to “next stage”
lab-orders.btn.next-stage.description: Moves the order to the next stage in the configured order with one click. Hidden once it is in a final stage. If it has no lab and the stage is not final, it asks for the lab first.

lab-orders.section.stage-progress.label: Progress
lab-orders.section.stage-progress.description: The stages of the workflow in order: past ones ticked, the current one highlighted and the remaining ones in grey.

lab-orders.section.detail-work.label: Job
lab-orders.section.detail-work.description: Requested services with quantity, teeth and note for each, or the job description when there are no services.

lab-orders.section.empty.label: No orders
lab-orders.section.empty.description: When there are no orders yet and no filters: a New order button and shortcuts to set up the module (lab services, lab categories and stages).
